items.label: Solar Powered Lantern
items.value: This solar lantern for outside comes with a solar panel and built-in sensors. The solar panel absorbs sunlight during the day and converts it into electricity. The built-in sensor will automatically turn on the light at dusk, providing you with warm light until dawn

items.label: Waterproof
items.value: The solar lanterns outdoor waterproof are lightweight and sturdy.The waterproof rating is IP65, which is not affected by most weather. High-quality materials make it last longer. Please keep away from fire or high temperatures

items.label: Decorative Rattan Lantern
items.value: Solar Lanterns Outdoor are made of rattan, purely handmade. The lights emit warm light and add a sense of ambiance to your yard. MAINLY FOR DECORATION, NOT FOR ILLUMINATION.

items.label: Widely Used
items.value: Solar Hanging Decorative Light can be used as beautiful night lighting decorative lights, which can be placed on table tops, gardens, lawns, or hung on porches, patios, trees, yards, paths.

items.label: Quality Service
items.value: Solar Hanging Lanterns are inspected before shipping. However, products may collide and cause damage during shipping. If you have any dissatisfaction with our solar lights, please touch us in time, we will provide you with a perfect solution

items.label: Festival Celebration Lights
items.value: The Intricate Textures and Patterns of the Woven Materials Add Warmth and an Enchanting Aura to Your Christmas Celebrations, Casting a Soft, Inviting Glow that Amplifies the Magical Charm of Both Christmas and Halloween. Whether Hung on Doorways, Draped Over Mantelpieces, or Nested Amongst Other Halloween Decor, This Lantern Evokes a Sense of Simple, Timeless Holiday Joy. Its Presence Reminds Us of the Pure, Everlasting Delights of the Festive Season

items.label: Kind Reminder
items.value: Turn switch to ON before first use,when charging the solar lantemn, please place it in a sunny spot and turn on the lantern's switc to start charging!
